purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: The official Ministry of Land Affairs lists Kikwit I and Kikwit II as land/cadastral jurisdictions in Kwilu. The official public-services catalogue describes cadastral and property-register access through the Conservateur des Titres Immobiliers or Cadastre Division, via formal paid requests. No public map or anonymous feature endpoint was found.
registryAssessment: Kikwit I and Kikwit II are explicitly named in the ministry’s current jurisdiction listing; public procedures are office-based requests rather than map data. No WUP-point cadastral polygon coverage is claimed.
